text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
That was so fun~! I mean, as expected of 
Kura-chan! You're even amazing at bowling!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: "It was just a fluke. Well then, I'll be—"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe! I'm really glad I got to see a new 
side of you, Kura-chan. After all, when 
you're busy, we don't get to hang out like 
this.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
I know! Want to go to karaoke after this? 
There's a song I want to sing together 
with Kura-chan and everyone!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"Only if you're not busy, of course... 
What do you think? Ah! O-Of course, no 
pressure at all—!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: No, it's fine! I'd be delighted to go.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
(I just have to make up for this with 
extra training later! OK! More 
importantly——)

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"Thanks for inviting me. Let's make 
memories and experiences... that we can 
only have right now!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Prioritizing hanging out with her friends, 
she ended up skipping her training.
